findings.element: Full-height chat shell (header pinned top / messages scroll / input pinned bottom)
findings.design: ChatPage is a full-height flex column edge-to-edge inside the content area: fixed 52px header flush to the top border, a flex:1 scrollable message region, and an InputBar flush to the bottom — no outer page padding (Artboard height 740, ChatPage `height:'100%'`, openspec/design/AgentChat.html:212-237).
findings.app: apps/web/app/pages/agent.vue has no `definePageMeta({ layout: ... })`, so it resolves to the default layout, whose `<main>` wraps page content in `px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 lg:px-10` padding and is not height-constrained (apps/web/app/layouts/default.vue:41-43). Comparable full-screen interactive scenes (session runner, mock exam) explicitly opt into `layout: 'minimal'` to avoid this (apps/web/app/pages/sessions/[id]/index.vue:18, apps/web/app/pages/mock-exams/[id]/index.vue:6) but agent.vue does not, so the chat panel is boxed in page padding and the whole page scrolls instead of only the message list.

findings.design: Per the artboard subtitle: "User bubbles: surface + secondary text. Agent bubbles: primary.default + white." UserBubble uses `T.surface` bg + `T.tSecond` text (openspec/design/AgentChat.html:119-125); AssistantBubble uses `T.primary` bg + white text (openspec/design/AgentChat.html:132-146).
findings.app: The roles are swapped: the user bubble is styled `border-readion-primary bg-readion-primary text-white` and the assistant bubble is styled `border-readion-border-strong bg-readion-background-surface text-readion-text-secondary` — the exact inverse of the design intent.
findings.reconciliation: Verified against the current implementation; retained as historical snapshot evidence.

findings.design: Every AssistantBubble instance is preceded by a 28x28 circular sparkle-icon avatar rendered inline beside the bubble (openspec/design/AgentChat.html:134-136).
findings.app: AgentBubble.vue renders only a small text label "Study assistant" above non-user bubbles; there is no avatar icon per message (the AgentStarAvatar component is only used in the page header and empty state, not per-turn).
findings.reconciliation: Verified against the current implementation; retained as historical snapshot evidence.

findings.design: The blinking cursor is rendered inline at the end of the last paragraph's text, inside the primary-colored bubble, colored white (`rgba(255,255,255,0.8)`) (openspec/design/AgentChat.html:24, 141).
findings.app: The cursor is a separate sibling block rendered after the entire message list (`v-if="isStreaming"`), not inside the last bubble/paragraph, and colored `bg-readion-text-muted` rather than white-on-primary.
findings.reconciliation: Verified against the current implementation; retained as historical snapshot evidence.

reconciliation.snapshotPolicy: Claude HTML remains visual hierarchy evidence; implemented live, accessible, theme, and responsive behavior is the product contract where static frames cannot demonstrate it.

statusVocabulary.resolved: implementation now matches the cited snapshot evidence
statusVocabulary.superseded: snapshot difference is an intentional product contract and is not an active defect

intentionalProductContracts.colorModes: Dark and light modes use semantic Readion tokens and meet 4.5:1 normal-text and 3:1 large-text/non-text minimum contrast.
intentionalProductContracts.controls: Controls expose rest, hover, active, focus-visible, disabled, selected, and action-local busy states with stable dimensions, reduced-motion handling, semantic state, duplicate guards, and operation-specific labels.
intentionalProductContracts.async: HTTP regions distinguish initial loading, content, successful empty, error with Retry, and content-preserving background refresh.
intentionalProductContracts.accessibility: Progress and outcomes are announced; modal focus enters a meaningful control, traps traversal, supports permitted Escape/backdrop dismissal, and returns to the opener.
intentionalProductContracts.responsive: Implemented shell screens contain content at 375px with wrapping or bounded local overflow while preserving the desktop artboard hierarchy.

reconciliation.agentTtl: No permanent four-hour chip is shown. The sliding inactivity TTL becomes visible only when actionable at 30 minutes or less, and activity clears the warning after the server extends expiry.
